patch_description: The two prior champions each peaked at 0.65 on opposite ends of the trade-off: lag_error=0.27 with high noise, and smoothness/false-reversals with lag. The hybrid composition keeps the current Kalman+RTS adaptive-R 3σ-gated backbone (which delivered lag 0.27) and adds the missing pieces: (1) keep the percentile-blended multi-scale SG (already present), (2) add a slope-lead compensation term driven by the *RTS smoothed slope* (the optimal low-noise derivative estimate, far less noisy than finite differences, so it restores dynamics without re-creating spurious reversals), gated by a *smooth sigmoid* in |slope| space rather than a hard binary gate — the hard gate causes discontinuities at the threshold that themselves register as slope changes. The lead magnitude is a modest fraction of the SG half-window, applied only where the trend is statistically meaningful relative to local noise scale. This attacks lag_error (still 0.27) while the sigmoid gating + already-achieved noise reduction (0.82) protects smoothness and false reversals, aiming to break the 0.65 plateau on the composite.
